text:
jess: Soft-activate plan for atlas-8b-slim tonight in NA/EU change window (23:00-01:00 PST). Will run staged traffic plus new circuit-breaker thresholds. Need ops + deploy ack. TLDR: staged 10% -> 30% -> 60% holds with 10m observation between steps.

deploybot: schedule accepted for 2025-06-01T23:00Z window. Rollout steps set. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/atlas-slim-soft-activate :white_check_mark:

sam: Ack. I'll watch p50/p95 and error-rate dashboards. Paging policy enabled.

maria: Can we lock fallback order explicitly? last time fallback went weird. Proposed:
- atlas-8b-slim:v1
- atlas-8b-quant:v2
- atlas-8b-base:v3
Also set pin_ttl 20m for canary.

jess: Agree. Add circuit-breaker thresholds and rollback triggers in the config below.

jess: ```yaml
fallback_order:
  - atlas-8b-slim:v1
  - atlas-8b-quant:v2
  - atlas-8b-base:v3
pin_ttl: 20m
circuit_breaker:
  error_rate_pct: 1.5
  sustained_window: 5m
  p95_ms: 650
  p95_window: 10m
  memory_oom: immediate
rollback_action: "rollback_to atlas-8b-quant:v2"
observe_between_steps: 10m
```

lee: +1. Also add a graceful-degrade route to small-context user flows to avoid huge p95 spikes (route short prompts to quant variant while full prompts use slim).

deploybot: dry-run completed. No conflicts. Canary slot reserved on pool-east-1.

anya: Ops thresholds noted. My team will be on call. If error rate > 1.5% for 5m OR p95 > 650ms for 10m then we initiate rollback to atlas-8b-quant:v2. If memory OOMs -> immediate rollback.

jess: Noted. I'll post release notes draft atm.

jess: RELEASE NOTE DRAFT: atlas-8b-slim (v1) — reduced model size for lower token cost; expected latency improvement for short prompts; will be launched staged with circuit-breaker. QA: perf/bs=1/512. See internal doc: https://redwood/docs/atlas-slim-release-notes

sam: +1. Ready for 23:00. I'll run fast health checks 5m after each step and ping here.

deploybot: execution window opened (23:00 PST). Step 1: route 10% traffic to atlas-8b-slim:v1.

deploybot: step1 complete. Observing metrics...

sam: p50 80ms, p95 420ms, errors 0.3% — healthy. Proceed to 30% in 10m.

deploybot: step2 complete (30%).

sam: p95 jumped to 690ms for a 2m blip, but p95 stabilized to 460ms. Error rate 0.9%. Holding.

anya: Holding OK. If p95 >700ms sustained, rollback.

jess: After 15m hold, proceeding to 60%.

deploybot: step3 complete (60%). Observing stable.

sam: Monitoring. All green. Closing ops loop. Leaving pin on fallback map for 30m.

jess: Thanks team. Postmortem note: keep smaller step if we see region-specific degradation next time. :sparkles:
